heroHeadline: May 10 Dialogue Collapses: Future Council Boycotts, Turkish F-16s Overfly Mogadishu — One Killed in Daynile Crackdown; T-4 Days to Constitutional Deadline
heroSubtitle: Somalia's political crisis hit a new inflection point on May 10–11, 2026: the Somali Future Council boycotted President Mohamud's dialogue session — the last realistic diplomatic window before the May 15 constitutional deadline — while thousands of opposition protesters filled Mogadishu's streets under security force blockades and an unprecedented Turkish F-16 overflight in a show of force for the FGS. On May 11, Xinhua confirmed one civilian killed by security forces in Daynile district, adding to the 6+ killed in the same neighborhood during May 7 land evictions. With no opposition attending May 10 talks and no mediated pathway remaining, the opposition's declaration that it will recognize Mohamud only as 'an ordinary citizen' after May 15 now appears imminent. Al-Shabaab holds Adan Yabal in Hiiraan for Day 22 with the SNA counter-offensive still unexecuted. Three pirate-held vessels — Honour 25 (16 days, 17 crew), Sward (15 days, 15 crew), and MT Eureka (9 days, 12 crew) — keep 44 hostages simultaneously captive, the most since the 2012 peak era. WFP's July 2026 shutdown warning remains in effect: 6M food insecure, 1.9M children malnourished, only 1 in 10 reached. AFRICOM stands at 62 confirmed strikes in Somalia for 2026.
footerNote: Data sourced from ACLED, OCHA, UNSOM, WFP, AFRICOM, EU EPF, EU NAVFOR, Combined Maritime Forces, UN Monitoring Group, and major international outlets. Casualty figures contested where noted.
